Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A brief report says unemployment edged down to 7.2%, with the latest jobs report bringing both relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant describes itself as a cozy, alpine-inspired restaurant serving traditional Swiss dishes such as cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. It highlights rustic wooden interiors, city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. Your introduction and contact email make it easy to identify you and get in touch. The content is quite minimal; adding a short bio, your interests, or examples of your work would help visitors get to know you better. My feedback is based on the text available on the site.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning your love of hiking gives the blog a personal touch and a clear starting point. I'd love to see posts about your favorite trails, hiking tips, or trip stories to give readers more to explore. My feedback is based on the text available on the site.
